{{Quote|The royal family was very understanding. They appointed a wonderful new Senator, Thariki, to replace me. I should see how she's doing...|Nadia Grell|<ref name="Padawan" />}}
'''Thariki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] representing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. She was appointed by the [[Sarkhai royal family]]<ref name="Padawan" /> several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.10.0}} Thariki was mentioned in [[Nadia Grell]]'s conversation with [[Jedi Consular]] class [[Alliance Commander]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odessen]], which took place in the ''Jedi Under Siege'' storyline. The precise date Thariki was appointed was not mentioned, but was at least several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of the storyline.</ref> to replace [[Nadia Grell]] in that position after Nadia realised she was unable to both be an effective senator and fight the [[war against Zakuul]] at the same time. Nadia expressed confidence in Thariki and hoped to catch up with her after Nadia [[Invasion of Ossus|defended]] the [[Ossus Colonization Initiative|colony]] established on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] from the invading [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Padawan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thariki was introduced in [[BioWare]]'s [[2016]] expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' to its [[2011]] [[Roleplaying game|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Nadia Grell's recruitment mission, "The Padawan and Her Master." This mission was exclusively available for [[Alliance Commander]] players of the [[Jedi Consular]] class on the planet Odessen.<ref name="Padawan" />
